attchmntText: HandsOn Global Management (HGM) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: HandsOn Global Management Limited submitted the newspaper publication of its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange. The results were published in the Financial Express and Pune Loksatta on November 14, 2026. The company reported a net loss after tax of Rs 88.44 lakh for the continuing operations during the period. This compares with a net profit of Rs 1255.04 lakh in the same quarter of the previous year. Total income from operations was Rs 996.15 lakh, down from Rs 1933.69 lakh in the prior year period. The earnings per share were negative Rs 0.71. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: HandsOn Global Management (HGM) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: HandsOn Global Management approved standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting occurred on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 914.45 lakhs for the quarter. Standalone loss for the period was 37.65 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations was 1,037.22 lakhs for the quarter. Consolidated loss for the period was 255.15 lakhs. Standalone basic earnings per share was negative 0.30. Consolidated basic earnings per share was negative 2.02. The statutory auditors issued unmodified review reports. The company has one reportable segment, IT and IT Enabled services. Subsidiaries include HOVS LLC and HealthCare Capital Holding LLC.
